statement: Whenever cherry_pickup(grid) returns a result r, r equals the maximum of V(p,q) over all pairs (p,q) such that p is admissible from column 0 and q is admissible from column C-1. A path p is admissible from column s when p(0)=s, 0 <= p(i) < C for all 0 <= i < R, and |p(i+1)-p(i)| <= 1 for all 0 <= i < R-1. For such paths, V(p,q) = sum_{i=0}^{R-1} (if p(i)=q(i) then grid[i][p(i)] else grid[i][p(i)] + grid[i][q(i)]).
preconditions: Let R = len(grid) and C = len(grid[0]). The input satisfies: 2 <= R <= 70; for every i with 0 <= i < R, len(grid[i]) = C; 2 <= C <= 70; and for every i,j with 0 <= i < R and 0 <= j < C, 0 <= grid[i][j] <= 100.

statement: For every grid satisfying the preconditions, cherry_pickup(grid) returns a result; it does not fail, panic, or overflow.
preconditions: Let R = len(grid) and C = len(grid[0]). The input satisfies: 2 <= R <= 70; for every i with 0 <= i < R, len(grid[i]) = C; 2 <= C <= 70; and for every i,j with 0 <= i < R and 0 <= j < C, 0 <= grid[i][j] <= 100.

statement: Whenever cherry_pickup(grid) returns r, 0 <= r <= sum_{i=0}^{R-1} sum_{j=0}^{C-1} grid[i][j].
preconditions: Let R = len(grid) and C = len(grid[0]). The input satisfies: 2 <= R <= 70; for every i with 0 <= i < R, len(grid[i]) = C; 2 <= C <= 70; and for every i,j with 0 <= i < R and 0 <= j < C, 0 <= grid[i][j] <= 100.

statement: For each row i with 1 <= i < R, let a_i be the largest entry in row i and b_i the second largest entry in row i, counting multiplicity, so b_i <= a_i and both are entries of row i. Whenever cherry_pickup(grid) returns r, r <= grid[0][0] + grid[0][C-1] + sum_{i=1}^{R-1} (a_i + b_i).
preconditions: Let R = len(grid) and C = len(grid[0]). The input satisfies: 2 <= R <= 70; for every i with 0 <= i < R, len(grid[i]) = C; 2 <= C <= 70; and for every i,j with 0 <= i < R and 0 <= j < C, 0 <= grid[i][j] <= 100.

statement: Whenever cherry_pickup(grid) returns r, r >= sum_{i=0}^{R-1} (grid[i][0] + grid[i][C-1]).
preconditions: Let R = len(grid) and C = len(grid[0]). The input satisfies: 2 <= R <= 70; for every i with 0 <= i < R, len(grid[i]) = C; 2 <= C <= 70; and for every i,j with 0 <= i < R and 0 <= j < C, 0 <= grid[i][j] <= 100.

statement: Whenever cherry_pickup(grid) returns r, r = 2 * R * v.
preconditions: Let R = len(grid) and C = len(grid[0]). The input satisfies: 2 <= R <= 70; for every i with 0 <= i < R, len(grid[i]) = C; 2 <= C <= 70; and for every i,j with 0 <= i < R and 0 <= j < C, 0 <= grid[i][j] <= 100. In addition, there exists an integer v with 0 <= v <= 100 such that grid[i][j] = v for every i,j.

statement: Whenever cherry_pickup(grid) returns r, r = sum_{i=0}^{R-1} (grid[i][0] + grid[i][1]).
preconditions: Let R = len(grid) and C = len(grid[0]). The input satisfies: 2 <= R <= 70; for every i with 0 <= i < R, len(grid[i]) = C; 2 <= C <= 70; and for every i,j with 0 <= i < R and 0 <= j < C, 0 <= grid[i][j] <= 100. In addition, C = 2.

statement: Whenever cherry_pickup(grid) returns r, r = grid[0][0] + grid[0][C-1].
preconditions: Let R = len(grid) and C = len(grid[0]). The input satisfies: 2 <= R <= 70; for every i with 0 <= i < R, len(grid[i]) = C; 2 <= C <= 70; and for every i,j with 0 <= i < R and 0 <= j < C, 0 <= grid[i][j] <= 100. In addition, grid[i][j] = 0 for every i with 1 <= i < R and every j with 0 <= j < C.

statement: Let h be the grid defined by h[i][j] = grid[i][C-1-j] for 0 <= i < R and 0 <= j < C. Whenever cherry_pickup(grid) returns r and cherry_pickup(h) returns r', r = r'.
preconditions: Let R = len(grid) and C = len(grid[0]). The input satisfies: 2 <= R <= 70; for every i with 0 <= i < R, len(grid[i]) = C; 2 <= C <= 70; and for every i,j with 0 <= i < R and 0 <= j < C, 0 <= grid[i][j] <= 100.

statement: Whenever cherry_pickup(g) returns r_g and cherry_pickup(h) returns r_h, r_g <= r_h.
preconditions: Let R = len(g) = len(h) and C = len(g[0]) = len(h[0]). Both g and h satisfy: 2 <= R <= 70; every row has length C; 2 <= C <= 70; and all entries are between 0 and 100. In addition, g[i][j] <= h[i][j] for every 0 <= i < R and 0 <= j < C.

statement: Whenever cherry_pickup(grid) returns r, there exist functions p, q : {0,1,...,R-1} -> Z such that p(0)=0, q(0)=C-1, 0 <= p(i) < C and 0 <= q(i) < C for every 0 <= i < R, |p(i+1)-p(i)| <= 1 and |q(i+1)-q(i)| <= 1 for every 0 <= i < R-1, and r = sum_{i=0}^{R-1} (if p(i)=q(i) then grid[i][p(i)] else grid[i][p(i)] + grid[i][q(i)]).
preconditions: Let R = len(grid) and C = len(grid[0]). The input satisfies: 2 <= R <= 70; for every i with 0 <= i < R, len(grid[i]) = C; 2 <= C <= 70; and for every i,j with 0 <= i < R and 0 <= j < C, 0 <= grid[i][j] <= 100.

statement: Whenever cherry_pickup(grid) returns r, for every pair of functions p, q : {0,1,...,R-1} -> Z satisfying p(0)=0, q(0)=C-1, 0 <= p(i) < C and 0 <= q(i) < C for every 0 <= i < R, and |p(i+1)-p(i)| <= 1 and |q(i+1)-q(i)| <= 1 for every 0 <= i < R-1, we have sum_{i=0}^{R-1} (if p(i)=q(i) then grid[i][p(i)] else grid[i][p(i)] + grid[i][q(i)]) <= r.
preconditions: Let R = len(grid) and C = len(grid[0]). The input satisfies: 2 <= R <= 70; for every i with 0 <= i < R, len(grid[i]) = C; 2 <= C <= 70; and for every i,j with 0 <= i < R and 0 <= j < C, 0 <= grid[i][j] <= 100.

statement: Whenever cherry_pickup(grid) returns r, r equals the maximum, over x in {0,1} and y in {C-2,C-1}, of grid[0][0] + grid[0][C-1] + (if x=y then grid[1][x] else grid[1][x] + grid[1][y]).
preconditions: Let R = len(grid) and C = len(grid[0]). The input satisfies: 2 <= R <= 70; for every i with 0 <= i < R, len(grid[i]) = C; 2 <= C <= 70; and for every i,j with 0 <= i < R and 0 <= j < C, 0 <= grid[i][j] <= 100. In addition, R = 2.

statement: Whenever cherry_pickup(grid) returns r, there exist functions p, q : {0,1,...,R-1} -> Z such that p(0)=0, q(0)=C-1, 0 <= p(i) <= q(i) < C for every 0 <= i < R, |p(i+1)-p(i)| <= 1 and |q(i+1)-q(i)| <= 1 for every 0 <= i < R-1, and r = sum_{i=0}^{R-1} (if p(i)=q(i) then grid[i][p(i)] else grid[i][p(i)] + grid[i][q(i)]).
preconditions: Let R = len(grid) and C = len(grid[0]). The input satisfies: 2 <= R <= 70; for every i with 0 <= i < R, len(grid[i]) = C; 2 <= C <= 70; and for every i,j with 0 <= i < R and 0 <= j < C, 0 <= grid[i][j] <= 100.
